Subject: Your Monday confirmation calls

Hi Dr. Achterberg,

Thanks for downloading the No-show playbook. You mentioned your front desk spends Monday mornings calling patients to confirm the week. That is the exact job Tidewater Appointments takes over: patients get a text two days ahead, reply C to confirm, and your team only calls the few who don't answer.

Practices like Northmoor Dental Group cut no-shows from 12% to 7% in one quarter this way.

Would you have 20 minutes this Thursday or Friday for me to show you how it would look for Beaverton and Tigard?

Best,
Jess Moreau
Sales Development Rep, Tidewater Scheduling
